SUBSTITUTE Gong,

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 16-M in the area
bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to West 63” Place; a line 251 feet west of and parallel
to South Central Avenue; West 63” Place; and, a line 276281 feet west of and parallel to
South Central Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Marty Quinn T
Alderman, 13" Ward

Common Address:
5626 West 63” Place
